paragraph: Jordan Love has 2,838 passing yards and 20 TDs this season. His Green Bay Packers play the Los Angeles Rams in Los Angeles on Wednesday, Nov 25. Both teams are 6-4. This is an exciting test in the playoff race! The Rams won 4 straight games before their bye.

big_words.definition: Something that makes you feel happy and eager.
big_words.example: Ava had an exciting birthday party with a giant cake.

paragraph: First place in the NFC North is at stake! The Chicago Bears and Detroit Lions are both 8-2. They play Thursday in Detroit. Bears QB Caleb Williams has 1,727 passing yards and 10 TDs this season. Lions QB Jared Goff has 2,716 passing yards and 20 TDs. Watch for the fierce matchup between these QBs.

big_words.example: Kofi stirred the cookie dough with fierce energy.

paragraph: Can the Eagles soar in Dallas? The 3-7 Philadelphia Eagles visit the 5-6 Dallas Cowboys. Dallas is second in the NFC East, and Philadelphia is fourth. Both teams are eager after wins last week! Dallas QB Dak Prescott has 3,049 passing yards and 25 passing TDs. Kickoff is Thursday, Nov 26, in Dallas.

big_words.definition: Really excited and ready to do something.
big_words.example: Lily is eager to add a tall tower to her block castle.

paragraph: 2,709 passing yards! That is Patrick Mahomes’ total for the 8-2 Kansas City Chiefs. On Thursday, the Chiefs visit the 9-1 Buffalo Bills in Buffalo. Bills QB Josh Allen has 2,527 passing yards and 14 TDs. Kansas City needs this game in its chase for the AFC’s top seed and the AFC West lead.

big_words.definition: To go after something you want.
big_words.example: Mateo and his puppy chase a butterfly through the garden.

paragraph: On Friday, Nov 27, the Denver Broncos visit the Pittsburgh Steelers in Pittsburgh. Denver is 8-2, and Pittsburgh is 6-4. Denver has won 6 straight and is tied for the AFC West lead! Broncos QB Bo Nix has 1,955 passing yards and 12 TDs. Can he dazzle us with a big pass?

big_words.definition: To amaze someone with something wonderful.
big_words.example: Zoe hopes to dazzle her friends with her colorful lemonade stand.

paragraph: The Bengals lost 22-20 to Washington in their last game. Now Cincinnati is home to face the New Orleans Saints! The 7-3 Bengals have a slim lead in the AFC North, while the Saints are 3-7. Saints QB Tyler Shough has 2,429 passing yards and 16 TDs. Watch Bengals QB Joe Burrow throw the ball: He has 3,095 passing yards and 29 TDs!

big_words.example: Ethan’s dog squeezed through a slim gap in the fence.

paragraph: The 6-3-1 New York Giants head to Indianapolis after a win! They face the 3-8 Colts. The spotlight is on Giants receiver Malik Nabers, who has 692 receiving yards and 2 TDs. Colts runner Jonathan Taylor has 760 rushing yards and 8 TDs. A win would help the Giants stay atop the NFC East standings.

big_words.definition: Special attention given to someone or something.
big_words.example: Nia felt like she was in the spotlight on her shiny bike.

paragraph: Geno Smith has 2,402 passing yards and 15 passing TDs this season. His 3-8 New York Jets visit the 1-9 Miami Dolphins in Miami. Watch Dolphins runner Ollie Gordon II, too! He has 608 rushing yards and 4 rushing TDs. These teams meet again in the AFC East after a close first game. Miami won that one 28-25!

big_words.example: Omar stood close to the glass to see a sleepy lion at the zoo.

paragraph: The Vikings are 1 game behind the Lions and Bears in the NFC North. Minnesota is 7-3 and hosts the 3-7 Atlanta Falcons in Minnesota. Falcons runner Bijan Robinson has 951 rushing yards and 6 rushing touchdowns! Vikings quarterback Kirk Cousins has 442 passing yards and 2 passing touchdowns in 2 games. Watch for a lively matchup: Robinson against the Vikings!

big_words.example: Grace made a lively splash at her swimming lesson.

paragraph: Can the Titans answer the Jaguars? Tennessee is 1-9, and Jacksonville is 7-3. The Jaguars lead the AFC South by 3 games. Trevor Lawrence has 2,585 passing yards and 22 touchdowns! Watch for dazzling throws! The game kicks off Sunday, Nov 29, in Jacksonville.

big_words.definition: So bright or wonderful that it catches your eye.
big_words.example: Leo saw dazzling stars above his tent on the camping trip.

paragraph: 33 sacks put Houston second in the league! The 4-6 Texans host the 4-7 Baltimore Ravens in Houston. Watch Zay Flowers, who has 785 receiving yards and 3 TDs. Texans QB C.J. Stroud has 2,656 passing yards and 22 TDs! Baltimore is determined to snap a 6-game skid and move up from fourth in the AFC North.

big_words.definition: Set on doing something and not giving up.
big_words.example: Priya was determined to nail her dance at the talent show.

paragraph: In Los Angeles on Sunday, Nov 29, the Chargers host the Patriots. The Chargers are 1-9, and the Patriots are 5-5. New England is just outside the 7-team AFC playoff field! Watch Omarion Hampton, who has 563 rushing yards and 4 rushing touchdowns. Can the Patriots find a clever way to slow him down?

big_words.definition: Smart at finding ways to do things.
big_words.example: Marcus made a clever volcano for his science project.

paragraph: Washington beat Cincinnati 22-20 in its last game! The 4-5-1 Commanders now visit the 3-8 Cardinals in Arizona. Washington is hopeful, sitting 2 games behind the Giants in the NFC East. Watch Arizona’s Trey McBride, who has 87 catches this season.

big_words.definition: Feeling that something good might happen.
big_words.example: Sofia felt hopeful as she ran toward the ball at recess.

paragraph: The 6-4 Seattle Seahawks head to San Francisco to face the 9-1 49ers. Watch these talented pass stars! Seattle’s Jaxon Smith-Njigba has 79 catches, 1,207 yards, and 10 touchdowns. San Francisco’s Brock Purdy has 2,624 passing yards and 23 passing touchdowns. A win would help either team in the NFC West standings.

big_words.example: On a rainy day, Jamal made a talented drawing of a bright red dragon.

paragraph: Fernando Mendoza has 458 passing yards and 3 TDs this season. His 4-7 Las Vegas Raiders play the 6-4 Cleveland Browns in Cleveland. They play on Sunday night! This is an important game for the AFC playoff race. The Browns are 4-0 at home!

big_words.example: Hana took a deep breath before her important spelling test.

paragraph: Carolina has a 2-game lead in the NFC South! On Monday, the 5-5 Panthers play the 3-7 Buccaneers in Tampa Bay. A win would help Carolina protect its lead. Bryce Young has 2,651 passing yards and 18 passing TDs this season. Watch for the matchup after Tampa Bay beat Carolina 43-13 in Week 7!

big_words.example: Diego used a cover to protect his library book from spills.
